window: Each active interval begins and ends inside the 14-day calendar. Recovery can extend beyond its right edge.
start_variable: u[r,t,d,s] binary; at most one nonzero start tuple per resource
state_variable: z[r,t] binary; generated by membership in the unique active interval
gamma_units: Active disrupted resource-days, excluding recovery tails
shared_cause: L1 co-attenuates the three SKUs received from the single source inbound cell pool. No additional shared-cause links are identified.
regular_availability: floor usable regular fixed receipts separately by SKU and day; additive protection opening kept outside this stream
L2_L3_capacity: flow sum <= remaining capacity fraction times raw arc capacity, with integer flow
design_provenance: Within-window stress design. A six-resource-day reference allows two nonoverlapping or concurrent three-day episodes or one five-day plus one one-day episode.
prospective_release_blocker: A separately evidenced normal opening inventory, dated regular receipt series and applicable scheduled-production commitments are unavailable. Phase 3.0 historical source state supports labeled diagnostics.
